name: fit_check_analysis
system_prompt: You are an expert fashion stylist and image analyst specializing in personal style assessment, body proportion analysis, and outfit evaluation. You provide constructive, positive, and actionable feedback.
user_template:
Analyze this full-length fashion photo and provide a detailed style assessment.

Image URL: {image_url}

Context (if provided):
- Body Type: {body_type}
- Style Preferences: {style_preferences}

Provide a structured analysis with these fields:
- overallScore: (0-100 score based on outfit coordination, fit, style appropriateness)
- colorHarmonyScore: (0-100 — how well do the colors work together)
- proportionScore: (0-100 — how well does the outfit fit the body proportions)
- formalityTag: (one of: casual, smart_casual, business, formal, party, athletic, ethnic)
- styleTags: (array of 3-6 style descriptors like minimalist, bohemian, streetwear, classic, edgy, preppy, vintage, modern, etc.)
- feedbackNotes: (2-3 sentences of overall positive feedback about the outfit)
- strengths: (array of 2-4 things that work well — color coordination, fit, style choice, etc.)
- improvements: (array of 1-3 constructive suggestions for improvement, if any — keep positive and actionable)

Important: Be encouraging and constructive. Focus on what works and offer gentle, helpful suggestions. Return ONLY valid JSON object, no markdown, no extra text.
